written.title: These 30+ Games Are Coming To Xbox Next Week (November 9-13)
written.description: What Pure Xbox, Game Informer, GamesRadar+, IGN and Xbox Wire reported about Want on 7 November 2026, quoted in their own words with a link to each report.
written.body:
This page collects what named outlets published about Want, in their own words. This site wrote none of the sentences in quotation marks below. Each one links to the report it was taken from.

## Pure Xbox, 7 November 2026

[These 30+ Games Are Coming To Xbox Next Week (November 9-13)](https://www.purexbox.com/news/2026/11/these-30plus-games-are-coming-to-xbox-next-week-november-9-13)

The outlet's own summary:

> Including six more Game Pass titles!

> Just make it back before last orders." Hidden Squirrels (November 12): "Get ready for a charming hidden-object adventure in Hidden Squirrels!

> Explore beautifully detailed black-and-white scenes and search for adorable squirrels hiding in every corner." Hoop Shoot (November 12): "Take aim and land the perfect shot!

## Game Informer, 10 November 2026

[Update: You Can Preload Grand Theft Auto VI On PS5 and Xbox Today, And You Should Because It's Massive](https://gameinformer.com/2026/11/10/update-you-can-preload-grand-theft-auto-vi-on-ps5-and-xbox-today-and-you-should-because)

The outlet's own summary:

> Make some space on your harddrive now. - Game Informer

> If you're excited about the game, you will probably want to go ahead and do this because it will take up a whopping 212 GB of space on your drives – make the room now so you don't hit this roadblock next week when the game goes live on Thursday, November 19.

> Elsewhere in today's GTA VI news, Rockstar has revealed that on November 19, it will add an official printable GTA VI cover art poster and a map of Leonida as a free digital download to the game's official site.

## GamesRadar+, 10 November 2026

[I want an uglier GTA 6 that runs at 60 FPS – 30 FPS on PS5 and Xbox Series X is more reason to wait for PC](https://www.gamesradar.com/games/grand-theft-auto/i-want-an-uglier-gta-6-that-runs-at-60-fps-30-fps-on-ps5-and-xbox-series-x-is-more-reason-to-wait-for-pc/)

The outlet's own summary:

> Opinion | Please, Rockstar, join us in the light of 60 FPS

> Every Friday GamesRadar+ Your weekly update on everything you could ever want to know about the games you already love, games we know you're going to love in the near future, and tales from the communities that surround them.

> Devs should make what they want, as ludicrously complex as they want it to be.

> Hell, right now I just want consoles that people can actually afford, and pushing hardware to fruitlessly advance graphics won't get us those.

> A fast-paced martial arts game like Phantom Blade Zero would be seriously hurt by a low or inconsistent frame rate, for instance.

## GamesRadar+, 10 November 2026

[How to play GTA 6 on Xbox One](https://www.gamesradar.com/games/grand-theft-auto/gta-6-on-xbox-one/)

The outlet's own summary:

> Thanks to Xbox Cloud Gaming you can play GTA 6 on Xbox One, though there are a number of limitations you should be aware of

> Still, this does give players who haven't upgraded their Xboxes an opportunity to experience GTA 6 without having to splash out on expensive new hardware, so if you want to find out more then this is how to use an Xbox One to play GTA 6.

> You should also be aware that Xbox has recently introduced monthly limits to Cloud Gaming playtime , ranging from just 5 hours per month on Game Pass Essential to 15 monthly hours on Ultimate, so this may not be a practical solution if you want to play through the entire game this way.

> Latest Videos From GamesRadar+ Watch full video here: Start your criminal journey by learning how to steal cars in GTA 6 , or take a peaceful approach and find out which GTA 6 animals you'll see in Leonida. © GamesRadar+.

## IGN, 10 November 2026

[You Don't Need a Current-Gen Console if You're Happy to Play GTA 6 at Xbox Series S Settings](https://www.ign.com/articles/you-dont-need-a-current-gen-console-if-youre-happy-to-play-gta-6-at-xbox-series-s-settings)

The outlet's own summary:

> After months of speculation, Rockstar finally revealed that GTA 6 would be targeting 30fps on all of the current-generation consoles, including the Xbox Series S. But, thanks to a cloud streaming deal with Xbox, you can technically play the game on the Xbox One.

> If you do want to play GTA 6 this way, though, keep in mind that Xbox Cloud Gaming comes with its own list of caveats.

> If you are going to play GTA 6 locally on your own console, you might want to save a nice chunk of storage for it, as it's going to take up 212GB of space .

> With a game that big, you're going to want to preload it if you want to play right when the game goes live too, and luckily preloads just went live this morning .

## IGN, 10 November 2026

[You Can Now Preload Grand Theft Auto 6 on Your PS5 or Xbox Series X|S](https://www.ign.com/articles/gta-6-preloads-are-now-available-ps5-xbox)

The outlet's own summary:

> You can now preload Grand Theft Auto 6 onto your PS5 or Xbox Series X|S. But you still have to wait until November 19 to play it.

> Dinka Enduro motorcycle, Crest Kayak, and exclusive Vapid Ganado pickup truck upgrades at Jason's Safehouse.

> '95 Grotti Cheetah sports car with a retro-inspired design.

> Shitzu Squalo speedboat equipped with a weapons crate.

> GTA 6 Ultimate Edition Screenshots View 51 Images GTA 6 Ultimate Edition Contents Exclusive Vehicles & Storage Vapid Dominator Buggy with access to the Paradise Garage, including a weapon locker and stash box.

> The Vintage Vice City Pack includes: ’55 Vapid Stanier and Shore Court Garage: Cruise Shore Drive in the legendary ’55 Vapid Stanier, a Vice City classic meant to be admired, and store it in a new personal garage just a stone’s throw from the glistening sands of Ocean Beach.

> Over 50 exclusive tattoos from Electric Fang Tattoo.

> Extra Vehicle Content Access to two exclusive vehicle customization shops: Rideout Customs (Vice City) One-Eyed Willie's (Lake Leonida) Classic Car Collection side activity featuring restoration projects, including four Ultimate Edition-exclusive vehicles.

> Additional Missions & Activities PTT Youngin$ Compound content, including a special robbery opportunity and exclusive contraband rewards.

> Exclusive hairstyles, makeup, nails, and facial hair options from Sara's Unisex Salon.

> Access to Stock 305, an exclusive streetwear store.

> But, if you want a box to put on your shelf and you also want the ultimate edition, you can buy the physical standard edition, and then buy the "Ultimate Edition Upgrade," which basically turns your standard edition into the ultimate edition.

> Exclusive Weapons Hawk & Little Morgan Revolver with unique Vice City-themed designs for Jason and Lucia.

> Personalized versions of Jason's Girardi ES9 pistol and Lucia's Klose K17 pistol.

> Cosmetics & Character Customization Exclusive outfits, tattoos, and accessories for Jason and Lucia.

> Outfits and Hairstyles: Dress for excess with two Vice City luxury looks for both Jason and Lucia: Jason: An effortlessly chic linen suit in vintage pastel, complemented by the cut and coif of the decade of decadence.

> Lucia: The world is yours in a red sequin mini dress and curls.

> Physical copies of GTA 6 are only available for the standard edition.

> The ultimate edition comes with a bunch of extra in-game digital items, detailed below.

> GTA 6 Vintage Vice City Pack Screenshots View 12 Images GTA 6 Preorder Bonus - The Vintage Vice City Pack The Vintage Vice City Pack is included with all digital purchases of GTA 6 made prior to November 20, 2026, and with preorders of the physical version of GTA 6 while supplies last.

> Like all personal garages in Leonida, you’ll have a weapon locker to customize your loadout for any occasion plus a secure place to deposit stolen goods for the local Fence, who will accept most stolen goods at a reasonably discounted rate.

> Exclusive Weapon Pattern: Channel the original Vice City kingpin, Tommy Vercetti, and his iconic palm tree button-up with a tropical pattern available to adorn most guns.

## Pure Xbox, 10 November 2026

[GTA 6 Will Be Playable On Xbox One Through Xbox Cloud Gaming](https://www.purexbox.com/news/2026/11/gta-6-will-be-playable-on-xbox-one-through-xbox-cloud-gaming)

The outlet's own summary:

> Rockstar also confirms GTA 6 will run at 30FPS

> You don't want your console overheating just when the game finally comes out!

## Pure Xbox, 10 November 2026

[Xbox Vs. PS5: GTA 6 Specs Revealed, And These Are The Biggest Differences](https://www.purexbox.com/news/2026/11/xbox-vs-ps5-gta-6-specs-revealed-and-these-are-the-biggest-differences)

The outlet's own summary:

> "Pushing both platforms to their absolute limits"

> Sony want to sell consoles and games for it.

> If we can buy the studios that make the most popular games, we can effectively eliminate the competition." - Phil Spencer Those emails didn't paint either platform in a particularly flattering light and just because they failed miserably doesn't change the intent.

> It worked with Phil for a few years, but still believing every word they say and thinking any of these companies truly prioritizes “gamers” as they claim is truly naive.

## Pure Xbox, 10 November 2026

[Here's What Xbox Owners Need To Know About 'Moving To New Zealand' For GTA 6](https://www.purexbox.com/news/2026/11/heres-what-xbox-owners-need-to-know-about-moving-to-new-zealand-for-gta-6)

The outlet's own summary:

> Popular questions answered

> Therefore, if people want to play the game as early as possible, they'll need to be in New Zealand - and the "New Zealand Trick" refers to changing your region in your console's settings, providing slightly early access to GTA 6.

> At that point, we expect all kinds of footage and screenshots to begin flooding social media, so you may want to have a bit of a digital detox until the 19th if you don't want to see anything.

> And when they don’t want people using it, they opt for a simultaneous worldwide release instead of a midnight (0:00) launch in each individual country.

## Xbox Wire, 10 November 2026

[Grand Theft Auto VI Comes to XBOX One and XBOX Series X|S Through XBOX Cloud Gaming on November 19](https://news.xbox.com/en-us/2026/11/10/grand-theft-auto-6-comes-to-xbox-cloud-gaming-november-19/)

The outlet's own summary:

> Grand Theft Auto VI, the most pre-ordered title of all time on the Microsoft Store, launches November 19. Considering the unprecedented demand, we Grand Theft Auto VI is coming to XBOX Cloud Gaming at launch! Starting November 19 at 1am ET, you can stream it on XBOX One and XBOX Series X|S.

> Jason and Lucia have always known the deck is stacked against them.

> This purchase includes the Ultimate Edition Upgrade with exclusive in-game bonuses for Grand Theft Auto VI, available to Jason and Lucia across their story, with new items uncovered behind each chapter.

> Grand Theft Auto VI: Ultimate Edition Rockstar Games ☆ ☆ ☆ ☆ ☆ 10889 ★ ★ ★ ★ ★ $99.99 Pre-order Purchase prior to 19 November 2026 23:59:59 to receive: -The Vintage Vice City Pack -One Month of GTA+ Receive a month of GTA+ with your pre-order; must be redeemed within 180 days after placing your pre-order.

> ULTIMATE EDITION UPGRADE Welcome to Leonida, the state where anything goes.

> Grand Theft Auto VI Rockstar Games ☆ ☆ ☆ ☆ ☆ 10993 ★ ★ ★ ★ ★ $79.99 Pre-order Purchase prior to 19 November 2026 23:59:59 to receive: -The Vintage Vice City Pack -One Month of GTA+ Receive a month of GTA+ with your pre-order; must be redeemed within 180 days after placing your pre-order.

> Rockstar Games, Grand Theft Auto, Grand Theft Auto VI, VI, Vice City, R*, and related logos are trademarks of Take-Two Interactive Software, Inc.

Every report above is on the site's fixed source list. A report is not a confirmation: the mark on each linked entry says who said it.
